name: Kangoku Hime ~Little Joou-sama no M Otoko Pet-ka Choukyou~
original_name: 監獄姫 ～リトル女王様のＭ男ペット化調教～
source:
‘Femdom,’ a special government-approved facility.
A terrifying place that advocates ‘female supremacy’ and rehabilitates (trains) men under this ideology.
The protagonist, Tomoki Nakano, who was sent to Femdom for theft, kept a low profile to avoid catching the attention of the female guards.
But one day, about a month after he entered the facility, someone noticed him.
It was a girl younger than Tomoki and not even a guard - Kikyou.

‘You will be my pet.’

From that day on, Tomoki began receiving training from this little brat...

[Translated from [url=http://herencia.nexton-net.jp/product/prison_princess/]the official website[/url]]
